dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。まず初めに年齢、性別、相談内容についてお聞かせ下さい。
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm the counselor. To start, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like to discuss?

dialogue.content: こんにちは４９才　女性高校生の息子のことをお願いします
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm a 49-year-old woman. I'd like to talk about my high school-aged son, please.

dialogue.content: 息子さんのことでご相談とのことですが、具体的にはどのようなことでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I understand you'd like to discuss your son. Could you tell me specifically what the concern is?

dialogue.content: 現在、高２なのですが、高１と時の成績から、落ちてきまして…
dialogue.English: He's currently in his second year of high school, but his grades have been dropping since his first year...

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。それはご心配ですよね。
dialogue.English: I see. That must be very worrying for you.

dialogue.content: はい特進コースなので、受験に関わるので…
dialogue.English: Yes, he's in a special advanced course, so it's directly related to his university entrance exams...

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。受験も近づいてきますのでより一層ご心配になられますよね。
dialogue.English: I understand. With the entrance exams approaching, I can imagine that makes you even more worried.

dialogue.content: そうなんです先日、保護者会で、先生から、大学進学は、難しいと言われてしまいました
dialogue.English: That's right. The other day at a parent-teacher meeting, his teacher told me that getting into a university would be difficult for him.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。それは、お聴きになられて辛いですよね。
dialogue.English: I see. That must have been very painful for you to hear.

dialogue.content: はい息子が中学３年生の時に、大学に行きたいというので、特進コースに行くようにしたんですが…
dialogue.English: Yes... when my son was in the third year of junior high, he said he wanted to go to university, so that's why we had him enter the special advanced course...

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。息子さんの希望をかなえ進路を決められたのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So you chose this path for him to fulfill his wishes.

dialogue.content: そうなんです小５から中２まで、大学行けるよう成績ではなかったんですが…私が中学３年生になる時に、塾を変わるようにしたのがきっかけで、特進コースに行けたんです
dialogue.English: That's right. From 5th grade through his second year of junior high, his grades weren't good enough for him to get into a university... But when he was starting his third year of junior high, I had him switch cram schools, and that was the turning point that allowed him to get into the special advanced course.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。息子さんの希望を叶えさせて上げる為に、色々考えられて実行されてきたんですね。
dialogue.English: I see. It sounds like you've put a lot of thought and effort into making your son's hopes a reality.

dialogue.content: はい、塾の先生から個別指導の報告が来るたびに、返信して、息子の性格にアプローチしてもらえるようにしてたんです。
dialogue.English: Yes, every time I received a report from his cram school on his individual tutoring, I would reply and ask them to tailor their approach to his personality.

dialogue.content: そうなんですか。息子さんの為に、一生懸命に尽力されてこられたんですね。
dialogue.English: I see. You’ve been working very hard on his behalf.

dialogue.content: はい小さい時からずっと手がかかる子だったので、自分なりにいろいろとやりました
dialogue.English: Yes, he's been a handful since he was little, so I've done various things in my own way.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。ご自分なりに息子さんのことを思って、今まで色々とやられてこられたんですね。
dialogue.English: I understand. Out of care for him, you’ve done a lot in your own way up to now.

dialogue.content: はいでも、なるべく甘やかさないように、バランスとってきたつもりなんですが、全然思うようにいかないですね
dialogue.English: Yes, but I've tried to strike a balance and not be overindulgent, but nothing seems to be going as I'd hoped.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。ご自分の思われるようには中々いかないとお感じになられているんですね。それは、お辛いですよね。やるせないですよね。
dialogue.English: I see. So you feel that things aren't quite going the way you'd like. That must be very painful and disheartening for you.

dialogue.content: そうですね中３の時の塾の送迎とかいろいろな労力や出費は、なんだったの？って感じます
dialogue.English: That's right... I find myself wondering what all the effort and expense was for, like driving him to and from cram school during his third year of junior high.

dialogue.content: そう思われるのは、自然だと思います。虚しさとかやるせなさが湧いてこられますよね。
dialogue.English: I think it's very natural to feel that way. It must bring up feelings of emptiness and frustration.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。私立高校で、朝学と夜学があって、サポートが厚いと塾の先生から聞いたので、今の高校に導いたのに、残念です
dialogue.English: Thank you. I guided him to his current high school because his cram school teacher said it was a private school with great support, offering morning and evening study sessions. It's just so disappointing.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。息子さんは、高１の時と、高２になられてから、何か変化がございましたか？？
dialogue.English: I see. Has there been any change in your son from his first year to his second year of high school?

dialogue.content: 体調不良で、時々、休んだり…早退で迎えにくるように先生から電話があります
dialogue.English: He's been absent sometimes due to feeling unwell... and I get calls from his teacher asking me to pick me up early.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。そういうことがおありなんですね。息子さんは、そのことについてどんなことを話されますか？
dialogue.English: I see, so that has been happening. What does your son say about it?

dialogue.content: 体調不良だから、しょうが無いと言います
dialogue.English: He says he can't help it because he feels sick.

dialogue.content: なるほど、なるほど。それは、ご心配ですが、体調不良の際は、医者には行かれているんですか？
dialogue.English: I see, I see. That's worrying, but does he go to the doctor when he's feeling unwell?

dialogue.content: コロナ禍なので、高校から病院行くように言われるので、行ってます
dialogue.English: Because of the COVID-19 pandemic, the school tells us to go to the hospital, so we do.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。息子さんに成績の件について、何か話をされていますか？
dialogue.English: I see. Have you talked to your son about his grades?

dialogue.content: はい、時々、話してます
dialogue.English: Yes, we talk about it from time to time.

dialogue.content: どんな内容の話をされていますか？
dialogue.English: What sort of things do you talk about?

dialogue.content: 高１の二学期から、夜学行かずに、毎日部活に行くようになったので、勉強時間、減ったのでは？みたいなことなどです
dialogue.English: Things like, 'Since the second semester of your freshman year, you've been going to your club every day instead of the evening study sessions. Don't you think your study time has decreased?'

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。息子さんは、成績がダウンして大学進学が難しい状況をどんな風に考えていらっしゃるのですかね？
dialogue.English: I see. How do you think your son views the situation, with his grades having dropped and his university prospects looking difficult?

dialogue.content: そのあたり、想像力がないみたいで、なんとかなるみたいな感じです。中３の時も私に泣きついてきましたから…
dialogue.English: He doesn't seem to grasp the severity of it; he acts like it will all work out somehow. He came crying to me for help in his third year of junior high, so...

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。息子さんについて、どなたかご家族とかにご相談されましたか？
dialogue.English: I see. Have you discussed this with any family members or anyone else?

dialogue.content: 担任の先生には、相談しました
dialogue.English: I've spoken with his homeroom teacher.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。担任の先生はどんな風に話をされていらしたのですか？
dialogue.English: I see. And what did the homeroom teacher have to say?

dialogue.content: 部活に行く曜日を減らして、夜学に行くようにとか…でも部活で部長ということもあり、部活に毎日行きたがるんですあと、夜学はほとんどみんな寝てるから自分も眠くなるから行きたくないとか…
dialogue.English: He suggested that my son reduce the number of days he goes to his club activities and attend the evening study sessions instead... But since my son is the club captain, he wants to go every day. He also says he doesn't want to go to the evening sessions because most of the other students are sleeping, and it just makes him sleepy too.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。１時間経ちましたので終了とさせていただきいと思いますが、如何でしょうか？統合まで持っていけず、すいませんでした。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much. Our hour is up, so I would like to conclude our session, if that's okay with you. I apologize that we couldn't reach integration.

dialogue.content: いえいえ、練習ですからね！話しやすかったです！ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Not at all, this is practice after all! You were very easy to talk to. Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.
